description: This file defines a StatelessWidget named SelectedColors that displays a row of color dots, allowing the user to select a color. It takes in a list of colors, the currently selected index, and a callback function for when a color is pressed.

classes.name: SelectedColors
classes.description: A widget that displays a list of selectable color dots.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the SelectedColors widget, including a label and a horizontally scrollable row of color dots.
